fact_packet.statement: Restless runs company work and returns evidence-backed decisions to the owner.

channels.author: founder
channels.reader: an owner following what the team learned
channels.plain_control: We learned that finished work matters more than visible agent activity.
channels.ai_heavy_negative: Operational intelligence compounds through an autonomous fabric of accountable outcomes.
channels.failure: abstract noun chain with no observation or consequence

channels.author: founder
channels.reader: a customer deciding whether to try Restless
channels.plain_control: You give Restless an outcome. It runs the work and brings the decision back to you.
channels.ai_heavy_negative: We are thrilled to announce a paradigm shift in the future of work.
channels.failure: institutional throat-clearing and unsupported prestige claim

channels.author: support lead
channels.plain_control: Your run stopped before it produced a result. We kept the work and will retry from the last verified step.
channels.ai_heavy_negative: We understand your frustration and are committed to delivering a seamless experience.
channels.failure: generic empathy without known state or next action

channels.author: operations
channels.reader: an owner whose decision is required
channels.plain_control: Your approval is needed. Restless will not send the message until you approve the recipient and content.
channels.ai_heavy_negative: Action required: unlock the next phase of your autonomous workflow journey.
channels.failure: status and consequence hidden behind promotional language

channels.author: product
channels.reader: a user recovering an interrupted run
channels.plain_control: Reply interrupted. Retry from the last verified step.
channels.ai_heavy_negative: Something magical hit a snag. Let’s get you back in flow.
channels.failure: unstable terminology and no precise recovery path

channels.author: founder
channels.plain_control: Most agent demos optimise for visible activity. In our runs, the useful measure was whether complete work returned with evidence and a decision.
channels.ai_heavy_negative: In an era of unprecedented transformation, agentic systems are redefining the very fabric of organisational intelligence.
channels.failure: non-standalone trend opening with no raw observation
